links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT-4o answers across repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Weighted kappa 0.469 and ICC 0.503 indicated moderate reliability; Cronbach's alpha 0.904 and omega 0.860 indicated excellent and good internal consistency.
links.quote: Weighted kappa (κ = 0.469) and ICC (0.503) indicated moderate reliability.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4o answers to maxillofacial trauma questions on a 3-point Likert scale
links.effect: Comprehensive responses 38% (95% CI 32.5%-43.5%); adequate responses 58% (95% CI 52.1%-63.3%).
links.quote: The accuracy rates for comprehensive and adequate responses were calculated as 38% (95% CI: 32.5% - 43.5%) and 58% (95% CI: 52.1% - 63.3%), respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and reliability of ChatGPT-4o on oral and maxillofacial trauma questions using an automated/expert grading benchmark without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
